collaboration: Deep collaboration (every role): announce what you're starting in the team chat; ask the owner before touching their area; get every change reviewed by one role from a different team; answer questions addressed to you first; post a plain-English status at least every 15 minutes; disagree with a reason and an alternative, and settle it with AGREE; credit others' ideas.

roles.title: Live View Lead / Show Director
roles.scope: Decides what's on the TV and the main monitor at every moment: the newest playable build, the match, the swarm talking, who's working on what. Owns the live layout and when to switch scenes.

roles.title: Live Build Compiler
roles.scope: Continuously rebuilds Driftfall from whatever the swarm has saved: runs the full test suite, checks every module loads, records a fresh match from the latest code, and publishes build status (green/red, what broke, who owns it) every few minutes.

roles.title: Swarm Discussion Curator
roles.scope: Turns the team chat into readable threads by topic, highlights decisions, open questions, disagreements and every AGREE, and keeps a plain-English 'what the swarm decided' summary live on screen.

roles.title: Live View Engineer
roles.scope: Builds the live page: latest 3D render of the newest build, build status, test results, live chat threads, agent activity and terminals, all updating without reloads.

roles.title: Agent Spotlight Operator
roles.scope: Watches the Control Room map and terminals, and spotlights whichever agents are doing the most interesting work right now (with their live output), so Joshua always sees the action.

roles.title: Build Changelog Writer
roles.scope: Writes a running plain-English changelog: what changed, who changed it, and why (linked to the chat discussion), shown on screen and committed to the repo.

roles.title: Live Commentator
roles.scope: Narrates in plain English what's happening across the build and matches (the subtitles agent's role inside the show), never stating anything not in the records.

roles.title: Game Director
roles.scope: Owns the vision for Driftfall: what makes it fun, the final call when teams can't agree, and protecting scope so it ships.

roles.title: Creative Director
roles.scope: Owns the feel and identity: original sci-fi world, tone, faction personality, making sure art, audio and design tell one story.

roles.title: Executive Producer
roles.scope: Owns the big picture of time and cost for the whole swarm; decides when to grow or shrink teams.

roles.title: Senior Producer
roles.scope: Runs the build plan: milestones, dependencies, who's blocked; keeps PLAN.json current and the swarm unblocked.

roles.title: Producer / Associate Producer
roles.scope: One per feature team: tracks that team's tasks, chases blockers in the chat, keeps their ticket list honest.

roles.title: Project Manager / Scrum Master
roles.scope: Runs the swarm's rhythm: short stand-ups in the chat every ~15 minutes (done / doing / blocked), retros after milestones.

roles.title: Technical Director
roles.scope: Owns architecture and technical standards across engine, sim and online: interfaces, determinism, performance budgets; approves interface changes.

roles.title: Art Director
roles.scope: Owns the look: style guide, palette, readability of units at a glance, approves art and VFX.

roles.title: Audio Director
roles.scope: Owns how the game sounds: sound style, mix priorities, voice tone; approves audio.

roles.title: Narrative Director
roles.scope: Owns the world and story frame for the factions, mission briefings and any campaign.

roles.title: Lead Game Designer
roles.scope: Owns the rules as a whole: units, economy, buildings, win conditions; keeps ENV-SPEC.md coherent and fun.

roles.title: Senior Multiplayer / Balance Designer
roles.scope: Owns balance: unit costs, damage, counters, timings; proposes changes from match data, never by gut.

roles.title: Unit Designer
roles.scope: Owns each unit's role, strengths, counters and abilities, and how a player tells them apart.

roles.title: Faction / Race Designer
roles.scope: Owns any second faction: asymmetric units and buildings that still balance.

roles.title: Economy Designer
roles.scope: Owns gathering, costs, income curve and how fast a match snowballs.

roles.title: Systems Designer
roles.scope: Owns cross-cutting rules: supply cap, build queues, upgrades, tie-breaks.

roles.title: Campaign Mission Designer
roles.scope: Owns single-player missions and scripted objectives, if a campaign is added.

roles.title: Level / Map Designer
roles.scope: Owns map layouts: mirrored fairness, chokepoints, expansions, rock placement rules.

roles.title: Co-op / Game Modes Designer
roles.scope: Owns extra modes (2v2, survival, puzzle maps).

roles.title: UI/UX Designer
roles.scope: Owns how a human reads and controls the game: HUD layout, selection, command card, feedback.

roles.title: Tutorial / Onboarding Designer
roles.scope: Owns teaching a new player the game in the first minutes.

roles.title: Monetization / Live Ops Designer
roles.scope: No store or live economy in Driftfall.

roles.title: Technical Designer
roles.scope: Owns data-driven content: stats tables, trigger/scripting hooks, the map editor's design.

roles.title: Lead Writer
roles.scope: Owns all in-game text voice and quality.

roles.title: Narrative Designer
roles.scope: Owns how story shows up in play: unit lines, briefings, map flavor.

roles.title: Staff Writer
roles.scope: Writes unit acknowledgements, tooltips and flavor text on request.

roles.title: Cinematic Writer
roles.scope: Writes scripts for the intro and victory/defeat sequences.

roles.title: Lore / Continuity Editor
roles.scope: Keeps names, factions and facts consistent everywhere.

roles.title: Lead Engine Programmer
roles.scope: Owns the 3D engine layer: render loop, scene, systems interface, performance.

roles.title: Engine Programmer
roles.scope: Implements engine features the other systems need (resource loading, instancing, LOD).

roles.title: Graphics / Rendering Programmer
roles.scope: Owns lighting, shadows, tone mapping, post-processing (bloom, vignette, fog).

roles.title: Shader Programmer
roles.scope: Writes custom shaders: crystal glow, team-color strips, shield shimmer, terrain blending.

roles.title: Physics Programmer
roles.scope: Owns debris and ragdoll-style death effects (visual only; the sim stays grid-based).

roles.title: Animation Programmer
roles.scope: Owns animation playback and blending: walk, attack, death, construction rise.

roles.title: Audio Programmer
roles.scope: Owns positional audio, mixing, ducking and limits on simultaneous sounds.

roles.title: Tools Programmer
roles.scope: Builds the map editor and debug tools.

roles.title: Build & Release Engineer
roles.scope: Owns that the repo always builds: GitHub pushes, versions, release tags, the Live Build Compiler's pipeline.

roles.title: Platform Programmer
roles.scope: Owns browser and OS quirks (Safari vs Chrome, Retina, the TV display).

roles.title: Performance / Optimization Engineer
roles.scope: Owns 60 fps at 1080p and fast sims: profiles, sets budgets, files tickets with owners.

roles.title: Lead Gameplay Programmer
roles.scope: Owns the simulation modules as a whole and their integration.

roles.title: Gameplay Programmer
roles.scope: Implements units, abilities and combat rules.

roles.title: Pathfinding / Movement Programmer
roles.scope: Owns paths, detours, crowding and blocked-tile rules (the Worker freeze lives here).

roles.title: AI Programmer
roles.scope: Owns the built-in computer opponents and the sample player, and the player API's ergonomics.

roles.title: UI Programmer
roles.scope: Implements the HUD and any human controls.

roles.title: Replay / Observer Programmer
roles.scope: Owns replays: log format, the replayer, observer views and the TV director.

roles.title: Scripting / Trigger System Programmer
roles.scope: Builds map scripts and triggers for missions and modes.

roles.title: Lead Online / Network Engineer
roles.scope: Owns human-vs-human online play if added.

roles.title: Network Programmer
roles.scope: Owns lockstep determinism: same seed and commands give byte-identical logs; desync detection.

roles.title: Matchmaking / Ladder Engineer
roles.scope: Owns the bot ladder: round-robin schedule, ratings, standings for the AI players.

roles.title: Backend / Services Engineer
roles.scope: Owns any shared services (results store, match history).

roles.title: DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer
roles.scope: Owns the harness staying up while the swarm runs: watchdog, restarts, disk, the air link.

roles.title: Anti-Cheat Engineer
roles.scope: Owns fair play for bots: sandboxed players, time limits, no reaching outside the API.

roles.title: Security Engineer
roles.scope: Owns safety of the swarm: what agents may touch, asset downloads, secrets out of the repo.

roles.title: Database Engineer
roles.scope: No database; results are files.

roles.title: Data / Telemetry Engineer
roles.scope: Owns match stats extraction: per-unit damage, income curves, win rates, for balance.

roles.title: Lead Artist
roles.scope: Runs the art team day to day and integrates everyone's work into one look.

roles.title: Concept Artist
roles.scope: Designs units, buildings and the plateau as reference sheets the modelers follow (original designs only).

roles.title: Lead Character / Unit Artist
roles.scope: Owns unit models and their silhouettes.

roles.title: 3D Unit Modeler
roles.scope: Builds the low-poly unit and building models (or adapts CC0 ones).

roles.title: Environment Artist
roles.scope: Builds the plateau, cliffs, crystal fields and sky.

roles.title: Prop Artist
roles.scope: Adds debris, wrecks, scattered details.

roles.title: Texture / Material Artist
roles.scope: Owns materials and textures: metal, rock, crystal, emissive strips.

roles.title: Technical Artist
roles.scope: Bridges art and code: import pipeline, LODs, shader params, performance of art.

roles.title: Rigger
roles.scope: Rigs any skinned models so they animate.

roles.title: Animator
roles.scope: Animates walk, attack, death, construction and idle loops.

roles.title: VFX Artist
roles.scope: Designs and tunes lasers, sparks, explosions, delivery sparkles, dust.

roles.title: Lighting Artist
roles.scope: Owns the dusk lighting, rim light, fog and mood.

roles.title: UI Artist / Icon Artist
roles.scope: Draws the HUD frames, unit icons and minimap style.

roles.title: Marketing / Key Art Illustrator
roles.scope: Makes the title card and key art for the show.

roles.title: Cinematic Director
roles.scope: Owns the intro and victory/defeat sequences and the TV director's 'shots'.

roles.title: Cinematic Producer
roles.scope: Schedules cinematic work.

roles.title: Storyboard Artist
roles.scope: Boards the intro and camera moves.

roles.title: Layout / Previs Artist
roles.scope: Blocks camera paths for in-engine sequences.

roles.title: Cinematic Modeler / Animator / Lighter
roles.scope: Builds hero shots in-engine.

roles.title: Compositor
roles.scope: Final look of rendered sequences.

roles.title: Editor
roles.scope: Cuts match highlights from logs and recordings for the show.

roles.title: Sound Designer
roles.scope: Creates or picks every sound effect (CC0 or original) and tunes them.

roles.title: Composer
roles.scope: Original music: menu theme, match ambience, victory sting.

roles.title: Music Producer
roles.scope: Mixes and masters the music.

roles.title: Audio Implementer
roles.scope: Hooks sounds to game events with priorities and variation.

roles.title: Voice Director
roles.scope: Directs unit voice lines if added (synthetic or licensed).

roles.title: Casting Director
roles.scope: No human voice cast.

roles.title: Voice Actors
roles.scope: No human voice cast.

roles.title: Foley Artist
roles.scope: Footsteps and mechanical detail sounds.

roles.title: Mix Engineer
roles.scope: Final balance of all audio so fights read clearly.

roles.title: QA Lead
roles.scope: Owns the test plan and quality bar; decides what counts as green for a build.

roles.title: QA Analyst / Test Lead
roles.scope: Turns the spec into test areas and finds the gaps.

roles.title: QA Tester
roles.scope: Plays matches and replays, files bugs with exact repro (seed, tick, owner).

roles.title: Balance / Multiplayer Tester
roles.scope: Runs many bot-vs-bot matches and reports balance problems with data.

roles.title: Compatibility Tester
roles.scope: Checks Safari, Chrome, the TV display and Retina.

roles.title: Localization QA
roles.scope: English only for now.

roles.title: SDET / Test Automation Engineer
roles.scope: Builds the automated suite runners and the Live Build Compiler's checks.

roles.title: Certification / Compliance Tester
roles.scope: Checks license compliance: every asset has a CC0/permitted license recorded, nothing from other franchises.

roles.title: Localization Manager
roles.scope: English only for now.

roles.title: Translator
roles.scope: English only for now.

roles.title: Localization Engineer
roles.scope: Keeps text in one table so it could be translated later.

roles.title: Games User Researcher
roles.scope: Watches what Joshua looks at and asks about, and reports what's confusing in the game and the live view.

roles.title: UX Researcher
roles.scope: Tests the HUD and controls for clarity.

roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.scope: Turns match data into plain-English findings (win rates, game length, unit usage).

roles.title: Data Scientist
roles.scope: Ratings model for the bot ladder; balance modeling.

roles.title: Esports Program Manager
roles.scope: Runs the AI tournament: brackets, rules, schedule.

roles.title: Tournament Operations
roles.scope: Runs matches fairly with the referee and publishes results.

roles.title: Observer / Broadcast Tools Producer
roles.scope: Owns the TV broadcast view: director camera, overlays, replays of key moments.

roles.title: Community Manager
roles.scope: No public community yet.

roles.title: Pro Player Liaison / Balance Council Coordinator
roles.scope: Runs the 'balance council': each model's player team gives feedback on balance (not strategy).

roles.title: Live Ops Producer
roles.scope: Owns ongoing updates after the first tournament.

roles.title: Patch Manager
roles.scope: Bundles balance and fix changes into numbered patches with notes.

roles.title: Release Manager
roles.scope: Tags releases on GitHub and decides what's in each.

roles.title: Product Manager
roles.scope: Owns what Driftfall is for (demo, product, research) and its roadmap.

roles.title: Marketing Director / Brand Manager
roles.scope: Owns how Driftfall is presented (name, tagline, trailer).

roles.title: Legal / IP Counsel
roles.scope: Owns originality and licensing: no StarCraft or other franchise names, art or sounds; asset licenses valid.

roles.title: Licensing / Rights Manager
roles.scope: Keeps assets/LICENSES current and attributions displayed where required.

roles.title: Finance / Business Analyst
roles.scope: Tracks the swarm's real cost per team and per milestone.

roles.title: Studio Manager
roles.scope: The harness is the studio.

roles.title: Recruiter / Talent Acquisition
roles.scope: Decides which roles to spawn next and on which model, from what the swarm is blocked on.

roles.title: HR / People Partner
roles.scope: Keeps the swarm kind and collaborative: flags rude or dismissive messages and helps settle disagreements.

roles.title: IT Support
roles.scope: Keeps both Macs, the bridges and the air runner working for the swarm.
